name: pranpan-monorepo
description: PRANPAN - AI-Powered PDF Summarizer and Document Assistant

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
